note: Moment registry + the 'life chooses the dimension' rotation. The user never picks a path; a light rhythm does. Engine reads this to select each day's Moment.

rotation.note: Not random and not user-chosen. A weighted rhythm so the sequence feels authored by the person's life, not shuffled.

rules.reason: a softer day follows a bold one
return gently, never with a harder dare

constraints: never repeat the same dimension two days running unless the user asks
never present a 'brave' default two days running
aim for >=3 distinct dimensions across any 6-day window (triangulation floor)
